statement: Define L1(s) as the largest L for which there exist integers l and u with 0 <= l < u <= len(s), u - l = L, and s[k] = 49 for every k with l <= k < u; if no such L exists, let L1(s) = 0. Define L0(s) analogously with s[k] = 48. The function returns a result r and r = true if and only if L1(s) > L0(s).
preconditions: 1 <= len(s) <= 100 and for every i with 0 <= i < len(s), s[i] = 48 or s[i] = 49.

statement: The function returns a result r (it does not fail) for every s satisfying the preconditions.
preconditions: 1 <= len(s) <= 100 and for every i with 0 <= i < len(s), s[i] = 48 or s[i] = 49.

statement: If s[i] = 49 for every i with 0 <= i < len(s), then the function returns true.
preconditions: 1 <= len(s) <= 100 and for every i with 0 <= i < len(s), s[i] = 48 or s[i] = 49.

statement: If s[i] = 48 for every i with 0 <= i < len(s), then the function returns false.
preconditions: 1 <= len(s) <= 100 and for every i with 0 <= i < len(s), s[i] = 48 or s[i] = 49.

statement: If len(s) = 1, then the function returns true if and only if s[0] = 49.
preconditions: 1 <= len(s) <= 100 and for every i with 0 <= i < len(s), s[i] = 48 or s[i] = 49.

statement: Define L1(s) and L0(s) as the longest lengths of nonempty contiguous all-49 and all-48 segments, respectively, with value 0 when the corresponding digit is absent. If L1(s) = L0(s), then the function returns false.
preconditions: 1 <= len(s) <= 100 and for every i with 0 <= i < len(s), s[i] = 48 or s[i] = 49.

statement: Define L1(s) and L0(s) as the longest lengths of nonempty contiguous all-49 and all-48 segments, respectively, with value 0 when the corresponding digit is absent. If L1(s) = 1 and there exists an index i with 0 <= i < len(s) and s[i] = 48, then the function returns false.
preconditions: 1 <= len(s) <= 100 and for every i with 0 <= i < len(s), s[i] = 48 or s[i] = 49.

statement: Define L0(s) as the largest length of a nonempty contiguous all-48 segment, or 0 if there is no 48. Whenever the function returns a result r with r = true, there exist integers l and u such that 0 <= l < u <= len(s), u - l = L0(s) + 1, and s[k] = 49 for every k with l <= k < u.
preconditions: 1 <= len(s) <= 100 and for every i with 0 <= i < len(s), s[i] = 48 or s[i] = 49.

statement: Define L0(s) as the largest length of a nonempty contiguous all-48 segment, or 0 if there is no 48. Whenever the function returns a result r with r = false, L0(s) >= 1 and every nonempty contiguous interval of indices on which all bytes are 49 has length at most L0(s).
preconditions: 1 <= len(s) <= 100 and for every i with 0 <= i < len(s), s[i] = 48 or s[i] = 49.

statement: Let t be the byte slice of length len(s) defined by t[i] = s[len(s) - 1 - i] for every i with 0 <= i < len(s). The Boolean result returned by the function on input t equals the Boolean result returned by the function on input s.
preconditions: 1 <= len(s) <= 100 and for every i with 0 <= i < len(s), s[i] = 48 or s[i] = 49.

statement: Let t be the byte slice of length len(s) defined by t[i] = 48 when s[i] = 49, and t[i] = 49 when s[i] = 48, for every i with 0 <= i < len(s). Define L1(s) and L0(s) as the longest lengths of nonempty contiguous all-49 and all-48 segments, respectively, with value 0 when the corresponding digit is absent. If L1(s) != L0(s), then the Boolean result returned on input t is the negation of the Boolean result returned on input s.
preconditions: 1 <= len(s) <= 100 and for every i with 0 <= i < len(s), s[i] = 48 or s[i] = 49.

statement: Let t be the byte slice of length len(s) + 1 with t[i] = s[i] for 0 <= i < len(s) and t[len(s)] = 49. If the function returns true on input s, then the function returns true on input t.
preconditions: 1 <= len(s) <= 99 and for every i with 0 <= i < len(s), s[i] = 48 or s[i] = 49.

statement: Let t be the byte slice of length len(s) + 1 with t[i] = s[i] for 0 <= i < len(s) and t[len(s)] = 48. If the function returns false on input s, then the function returns false on input t.
preconditions: 1 <= len(s) <= 99 and for every i with 0 <= i < len(s), s[i] = 48 or s[i] = 49.

statement: For every index i with 0 <= i < len(s) and s[i] = 48, let t be the byte slice of the same length as s with t[i] = 49 and t[j] = s[j] for every j with 0 <= j < len(s) and j != i. If the function returns true on input s, then the function returns true on input t.
preconditions: 1 <= len(s) <= 100 and for every i with 0 <= i < len(s), s[i] = 48 or s[i] = 49.

statement: For every index i with 0 <= i < len(s) and s[i] = 49, let t be the byte slice of the same length as s with t[i] = 48 and t[j] = s[j] for every j with 0 <= j < len(s) and j != i. If the function returns false on input s, then the function returns false on input t.
preconditions: 1 <= len(s) <= 100 and for every i with 0 <= i < len(s), s[i] = 48 or s[i] = 49.
